metadata.title: Trusted Supply Chain

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing third‑party trust, vendor risk, and software supply chain exposure without granting system access, execution authority, or safety guarantees.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Vendor governance, third‑party access management, software dependencies, toolchains, and external SDLC inputs.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern assembling all Trusted Supply Chain solution patterns into a single governance and trust domain.

props.name: trust-model
props.remarks: All external vendors, software, and services are untrusted until explicitly assessed and constrained.

props.name: nist-controls
props.value: SR, RA, IA, AC, AU, SI, CM, SA, PL
props.remarks: Trusted Supply Chain governs supply chain risk and third‑party trust controls across the enterprise.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices.

metadata.remarks: Trusted Supply Chain composes governance and technical patterns that assess, constrain, and monitor third‑party and supply‑chain risk. Trust signals produced by this domain do not imply deployment authority, runtime execution permission, or safety certification.

components.title: Vendor Risk Management
components.description: Assesses and governs organizational risk posed by third‑party vendors.

components.title: Third‑Party Privileged Access
components.description: Constrains and monitors privileged access granted to external personnel or systems.

components.title: Software Supply Chain
components.description: Governs ingestion and integrity of third‑party software, tooling, and build inputs.

components.title: Dependency Transparency
components.description: Provides visibility into software composition and dependency relationships.
